items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: And Lawrence, we got, we got, we made a band. And we called it the, the original Diamond Orchestra.

ctx.x: What was the first band you played in, around here? You know, the first organized band.
The first, the first organized band that I played in, was my own band. And Lawrence, we got, we got, we made a band. And we called it the, the original Diamond Orchestra.
